verse.verse_1: Say, "It has been revealed to me that a band of the jinn listened [to the Quran] and they said, "We have heard a really wonderful recital,
verse.verse_2: which guides to the right path; so we have believed in it and we will not associate anyone with our Lord,
verse.verse_3: and exalted is the majesty of our Lord, He has taken neither a wife nor a son.
verse.verse_4: And [now we know] that the foolish among us have been saying outrageous things about God.
verse.verse_5: We had supposed that men and jinn would never utter a lie against God.
verse.verse_6: Some men used to seek refuge with the jinn in the past, but that only increased their insolence.
verse.verse_7: They thought, as you did, that God would never raise up anyone from the dead.
verse.verse_8: We sought to reach heaven, but found it filled with strong guards and flames --
verse.verse_9: we used to take up a position to listen, but whoever listens now finds a flaming fire lying in wait for him --
verse.verse_10: we cannot tell if this bodes evil to those who dwell on earth or whether their Lord intends to guide them.
verse.verse_11: Some of us are righteous, while others are not; we follow divergent paths.
verse.verse_12: We have realized that we could never thwart God on earth and that we would never be able to thwart Him by flight.
verse.verse_13: When we heard the call to guidance, we believed in it. He who believes in his Lord has no fear of loss or of injustice.
verse.verse_14: Some of us are obedient while others are wrongdoers; it is the obedient who have found the right path,
verse.verse_15: but those who are wrongdoers will become the fuel of Hell."
verse.verse_16: If they had followed the right path, We would have provided them with abundant rain --
verse.verse_17: so that We may test them by it -- whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord shall be sternly punished.
verse.verse_18: The mosques are for God's worship -- so do not invoke anyone else along with God --
verse.verse_19: when God's servant stood up to pray to Him, they pressed close to him in great numbers, almost stifling him.
verse.verse_20: Say, "I call only upon my Lord and do not associate anyone else with Him."
verse.verse_21: Say, "It is not in my power to cause you either harm or good?"
verse.verse_22: Say, "Surely no one can protect me against God, nor can I find besides Him any place of refuge.
verse.verse_23: My duty is only to convey that which I receive from Him and His messages." For those who disobey God and His Messenger there is the fire of hell, wherein they will abide forever.
verse.verse_24: When they are confronted by what they have been promised, they will realize who is weaker in helpers and fewer in numbers.
verse.verse_25: Say, "I do not know whether what you are promised is imminent, or whether my Lord has set for it a far-off day.
verse.verse_26: He alone has knowledge of what is hidden. He reveals this to none,
verse.verse_27: except the messenger whom He has chosen. He sends down guardians who walk before them and behind them,
verse.verse_28: so that He may know that the messengers have delivered the messages of their Lord. He encompasses all that is with them and He keeps count of all things.
